<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>API Documentation | DigitalCore</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link
        href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap"
        rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="icon" type="image/jpeg" href="assets/logo.jpg">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css?v=67">

    <style>
        :root {
            --docs-sidebar-w: 280px;
            --badge-get: #10b981;
            --badge-post: #3b82f6;
            --badge-put: #f59e0b;
            --badge-del: #ef4444;
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-main);
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* Click / Active Animation matching Support button */
        .contact-btn,
        .copy-btn,
        .theme-toggle-btn,
        .slug-pill,
        .sidebar-link {
            transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .contact-btn:hover,
        .copy-btn:hover,
        .theme-toggle-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .contact-btn:active,
        .copy-btn:active,
        .theme-toggle-btn:active,
        .slug-pill:active {
            transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97);
        }

        .docs-container {
            display: flex;
            max-width: 1560px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding-top: 5rem;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Sidebar Navigation */
        .docs-sidebar {
            width: var(--docs-sidebar-w);
            position: sticky;
            top: 5rem;
            height: calc(100vh - 5rem);
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 2rem 1.5rem 2rem 2rem;
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            scrollbar-width: thin;
        }

        .docs-sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
        }
        .docs-sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .sidebar-section {
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        .sidebar-title {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .sidebar-link {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #ccc;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .sidebar-link:hover, .sidebar-link.active {
            color: #fff;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        }

        .method-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.68rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        .method-tag.get {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: #10b981;
            border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
        }

        .method-tag.post {
            background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15);
            color: #60a5fa;
            border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
        }

        /* Content Area */
        .docs-content {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 3rem 4rem 6rem;
            max-width: 1180px;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .docs-hero {
            margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
            padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        .docs-hero h1 {
            font-size: 3.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -1.5px;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #a1a1aa 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .docs-hero p {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.6;
            max-width: 820px;
        }

        .base-url-box {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .base-url-box span.label {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .base-url-box code {
            color: var(--gold);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* Callout Box */
        .callout-box {
            background: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.25);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .callout-box.info {
            background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05);
            border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25);
        }

        .callout-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .callout-header svg {
            color: var(--gold);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .callout-box.info .callout-header svg {
            color: #60a5fa;
        }

        .callout-body {
            color: #d1d5db;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .callout-body a {
            color: var(--gold);
            text-decoration: underline;
            text-underline-offset: 3px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* Section Headings */
        .doc-section {
            margin-bottom: 4.5rem;
            scroll-margin-top: 6.5rem;
        }

        .doc-section-title {
            font-size: 2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .doc-section-desc {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Endpoint Card */
        .endpoint-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 18px;
            padding: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
            transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.3s ease;
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        .endpoint-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
        }

        .endpoint-header {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
            padding-bottom: 1.25rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        .endpoint-path-wrap {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .endpoint-method {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        .endpoint-method.get {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18);
            color: #34d399;
            border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
        }

        .endpoint-method.post {
            background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18);
            color: #60a5fa;
            border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
        }

        .endpoint-path {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #ffffff;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .endpoint-desc {
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: #d1d5db;
            margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Parameter Tables */
        .subheading {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .params-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .params-table th {
            text-align: left;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 600;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        .params-table td {
            padding: 12px 14px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            color: #d1d5db;
            vertical-align: top;
        }

        .param-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .param-type {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: #a1a1aa;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
        }

        .param-req {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .param-req.required {
            background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
            color: #f87171;
            border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
        }

        .param-req.optional {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            color: #9ca3af;
        }

        /* Code Snippet Box with Horizontal Scroll Constraints */
        .code-box {
            background: #090a0d;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            position: relative;
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        .code-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .code-content {
            padding: 16px;
            margin: 0;
            overflow-x: auto;
            max-width: 100%;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            line-height: 1.55;
            color: #e5e7eb;
            white-space: pre;
            scrollbar-width: thin;
        }

        .code-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
            height: 6px;
        }

        .code-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .copy-btn {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            color: #ccc;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .copy-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            color: #fff;
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
        }

        /* Interactive Products Table */
        .products-table-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 18px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
            transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.2s;
        }

        .products-table-header {
            padding: 1.5rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015);
        }

        .table-search-input {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: #fff;
            padding: 8px 14px 8px 36px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            outline: none;
            width: 280px;
            transition: border-color 0.2s;
        }

        .table-search-input:focus {
            border-color: var(--gold);
        }

        .search-wrap {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .search-icon {
            position: absolute;
            left: 12px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .prod-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 0.92rem;
        }

        .prod-table th {
            text-align: left;
            padding: 14px 18px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 600;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

        .prod-table td {
            padding: 16px 18px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            color: #d1d5db;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .prod-table tr:hover td {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
        }

        .prod-name-cell {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .prod-logo-img {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            object-fit: cover;
            background: #18181b;
        }

        .slug-pill {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #f3f4f6;
        }

        .slug-pill:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.12);
            border-color: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.35);
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .stock-indicator {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        .stock-dot {
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #10b981;
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.8);
        }

        .stock-dot.out {
            background: #ef4444;
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.8);
        }

        .tier-badge-chip {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            margin: 2px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }

        /* Toast Notification */
        .copy-toast {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 24px;
            right: 24px;
            background: #10b981;
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.88rem;
            padding: 10px 18px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            transform: translateY(100px);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            z-index: 9999;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .copy-toast.show {
            transform: translateY(0);
            opacity: 1;
        }

        /* ============================================================ */
        /* LIGHT THEME COMPREHENSIVE FIXES FOR DOCS                     */
        /* ============================================================ */
        body.light-theme {
            --bg-dark: #f2f2f7;
            --bg-card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
            --border-subtle: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            --border-hover: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            --text-main: #18181b;
            --text-muted: #64748b;
        }

        body.light-theme .logo-text {
            color: #18181b !important;
        }

        body.light-theme .docs-sidebar {
            border-right-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }

        body.light-theme .sidebar-link {
            color: #475569;
        }

        body.light-theme .sidebar-link:hover,
        body.light-theme .sidebar-link.active {
            color: #0f172a;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        }

        body.light-theme .docs-hero h1 {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0f172a 0%, #475569 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        body.light-theme .base-url-box {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
        }

        body.light-theme .callout-box {
            background: #fffbeb;
            border-color: #fde68a;
        }

        body.light-theme .callout-header {
            color: #92400e;
        }

        body.light-theme .callout-body {
            color: #78350f;
        }

        body.light-theme .callout-box.info {
            background: #eff6ff;
            border-color: #bfdbfe;
        }

        body.light-theme .callout-box.info .callout-header {
            color: #1e40af;
        }

        body.light-theme .callout-box.info .callout-body {
            color: #1e3a8a;
        }

        body.light-theme .endpoint-card {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        }

        body.light-theme .endpoint-path {
            color: #0f172a;
        }

        body.light-theme .endpoint-desc {
            color: #334155;
        }

        body.light-theme .params-table th {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
            color: #475569;
            border-bottom-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }

        body.light-theme .params-table td {
            color: #334155;
            border-bottom-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }

        body.light-theme .param-name {
            color: #0f172a;
        }

        body.light-theme .param-type {
            color: #64748b;
        }

        body.light-theme .code-box {
            background: #f8fafc;
            border-color: #e2e8f0;
        }

        body.light-theme .code-header {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            border-bottom-color: #e2e8f0;
            color: #64748b;
        }

        body.light-theme .code-content {
            color: #0f172a;
        }

        body.light-theme .code-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        }

        body.light-theme .copy-btn {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-color: #cbd5e1;
            color: #475569;
        }

        body.light-theme .copy-btn:hover {
            background: #f8fafc;
            color: #0f172a;
            border-color: #94a3b8;
        }

        body.light-theme .products-table-card {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        }

        body.light-theme .products-table-header {
            background: #f8fafc;
            border-bottom-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }

        body.light-theme .table-search-input {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-color: #cbd5e1;
            color: #0f172a;
        }

        body.light-theme .prod-table th {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
            color: #64748b;
            border-bottom-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }

        body.light-theme .prod-table td {
            color: #334155;
            border-bottom-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }

        body.light-theme .prod-table tr:hover td {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.015);
        }

        body.light-theme .prod-name-cell {
            color: #0f172a;
        }

        body.light-theme .slug-pill {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            border-color: #e2e8f0;
            color: #0f172a;
        }

        body.light-theme .slug-pill:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.15);
            border-color: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.4);
            color: #b45309;
        }

        body.light-theme .tier-badge-chip {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            border-color: #e2e8f0;
            color: #334155;
        }

        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .docs-sidebar {
                display: none;
            }
            .docs-content {
                padding: 2rem 1.5rem 5rem;
            }
            .docs-hero h1 {
                font-size: 2.4rem;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>

    <!-- Top Navbar -->
    <nav class="navbar">
        <div class="logo">
            <a href="/" style="display: flex; align-items: center; text-decoration: none;">
                <img src="assets/logo.jpg" alt="DigitalCore Logo" style="height: 40px; border-radius: 7px;">
            </a>
        </div>
        <div class="nav-links">
            <a href="/" class="contact-btn" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                    <path d="M3 9l9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"></path>
                    <polyline points="9 22 9 12 15 12 15 22"></polyline>
                </svg>
                General
            </a>

            <section class="doc-section" id="endpoint-buy">

                    <div class="endpoint-desc">
                        Instantly purchases products using your Telegram bot account balance.
                        <br><br>
                        <strong>Zero Race Condition Guarantee:</strong> Uses database row-locking and atomic transactional key reservation. If stock is insufficient or balance is low, the transaction is fully rolled back, preventing double-spending and overselling under high concurrency.
                    </div>

                        Fetches single order details and delivered key items. Access is strictly verified against your authenticated account (you can only view your own orders).
                    </div>

                    <div class="subheading">Query Parameters</div>
                    <table class="params-table">
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th>Parameter</th>
                                <th>Type</th>
                                <th>Required</th>
                                <th>Description</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            <tr>
                                <td><span class="param-name">id</span></td>
                                <td><span class="param-type">string</span></td>
                                <td><span class="param-req required">Required</span></td>
                                <td>Order number (e.g. <code>ORD-3232432</code>).</td>
                            </tr>
                        </tbody>
                    </table>

                    <div class="subheading">Request Example</div>
                    <div class="code-box">
                        <div class="code-header">
                            <span>curl</span>
                            <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyText('curl -s -H "Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" "https://digitalcore.top/api/user/order?id=ORD-3232432"')">Copy</button>
                        </div>
                        <pre class="code-content"><code>curl -s -H "Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  "https://digitalcore.top/api/user/order?id=ORD-3232432"</code></pre>
                    </div>

                    <div class="subheading">Response Example (200 OK)</div>
                    <div class="code-box">
                        <div class="code-header">
                            <span>JSON</span>
                            <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyText(document.getElementById('code-resp-order').innerText)">Copy</button>
                        </div>
                        <pre class="code-content" id="code-resp-order"><code>{
  "order_id": "ORD-3232432",
  "view_url": "https://digitalcore.top/order?number=a2de1869-3524-41d8-1bc2-f0722d73e071",
  "total_amount": 0.55,
  "quantity": 1,
  "items": [
    "https://g.co/gemini/share/sample_activation_token_123"
  ]
}</code></pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <!-- Error Codes Reference -->
            <section class="doc-section" id="errors">
                <h2 class="doc-section-title">Error Codes Reference</h2>
                <p class="doc-section-desc">
                    Standard error codes returned by the API inside <code>{"success": false, "msg": "..."}</code>:
                </p>

                <table class="params-table">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>Status Code</th>
                            <th>Error Message (<code>msg</code>)</th>
                            <th>Description</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>401 Unauthorized</code></td>
                            <td><code>MISSING_API_KEY</code></td>
                            <td>The <code>Api-Key</code> header was omitted from the request.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>401 Unauthorized</code></td>
                            <td><code>INVALID_API_KEY</code></td>
                            <td>The provided API key is invalid or does not match any registered account.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>400 Bad Request</code></td>
                            <td><code>INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE</code></td>
                            <td>Your Telegram bot balance is lower than the order total amount. Top up in bot first.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>400 Bad Request</code></td>
                            <td><code>OUT_OF_STOCK</code></td>
                            <td>Not enough keys available in stock to fulfill the requested quantity.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>400 Bad Request</code></td>
                            <td><code>ID_REQUIRED</code></td>
                            <td>The <code>id</code> parameter is missing from the request.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>400 Bad Request</code></td>
                            <td><code>INVALID_COUNT</code></td>
                            <td>The <code>count</code> quantity must be a positive integer >= 1.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>400 Bad Request</code></td>
                            <td><code>MAX_COUNT_EXCEEDED</code></td>
                            <td>Maximum purchase volume is 1,000 items per single order request.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>404 Not Found</code></td>
                            <td><code>PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND</code></td>
                            <td>Product does not exist or has been hidden by administration.</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td><code>404 Not Found</code></td>
                            <td><code>ORDER_NOT_FOUND</code></td>
                            <td>Order number was not found or belongs to another user account.</td>
                        </tr>
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </section>
        </main>
    </div>

    <!-- Toast Notification -->
    <div id="copyToast" class="copy-toast">
